description: Metadata-only snapshot of eight legacy tables before the nineteen Google migrations; no clinical rows or credentials. Auto-increment counters omitted.

ddl.GoogleConnections:
CREATE TABLE `GoogleConnections` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `userId` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `googleUserId` varchar(128) NOT NULL,
  `userEmail` varchar(256) DEFAULT NULL,
  `accessToken` text NOT NULL,
  `refreshToken` text,
  `scopes` text,
  `expiresAt` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `userName` varchar(256) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uniq_google_connections_user_provider` (`userId`,`googleUserId`),
  KEY `google_connections_user_id` (`userId`),
  KEY `google_connections_google_user_id` (`googleUserId`),
  CONSTRAINT `GoogleConnections_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`userId`) REFERENCES `Usuarios` (`id_usuario`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

ddl.GoogleConnectionAssignments:
CREATE TABLE `GoogleConnectionAssignments` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `scopeKey` varchar(64) NOT NULL,

  `status` enum('active','reauthorization_required','revoked','disconnected') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
  `authorizedByUserId` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `authorizedByName` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `authorizedByEmail` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `connectedAt` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `lastValidatedAt` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `lastErrorCode` varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL,
  `lastErrorMessage` text,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `scopeKey` (`scopeKey`),
  KEY `authorizedByUserId` (`authorizedByUserId`),
  KEY `idx_google_connection_assignments_connection` (`googleConnectionId`),
  KEY `idx_google_connection_assignments_clinic` (`clinicaId`),
  KEY `idx_google_connection_assignments_group` (`grupoClinicaId`),
  KEY `idx_google_connection_assignments_status` (`status`),
  CONSTRAINT `GoogleConnectionAssignments_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`clinicaId`) REFERENCES `Clinicas` (`id_clinica`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `GoogleConnectionAssignments_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`grupoClinicaId`) REFERENCES `GruposClinicas` (`id_grupo`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `GoogleConnectionAssignments_ibfk_3` FOREIGN KEY (`googleConnectionId`) REFERENCES `GoogleConnections` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `GoogleConnectionAssignments_ibfk_4` FOREIGN KEY (`authorizedByUserId`) REFERENCES `Usuarios` (`id_usuario`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

ddl.GoogleAdsConversionUploadAttempts:
CREATE TABLE `GoogleAdsConversionUploadAttempts` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `dedupe_key` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `clinica_id` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `grupo_clinica_id` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `intake_config_id` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `google_connection_id` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `google_connection_assignment_id` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `assignment_scope` enum('clinic','group') NOT NULL,
  `destination_key` varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL,
  `connection_source` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL,
  `customer_id` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL,
  `login_customer_id` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL,
  `conversion_action` varchar(256) DEFAULT NULL,
  `event_name` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `event_id` varchar(191) DEFAULT NULL,
  `click_id_type` enum('gclid','gbraid','wbraid') DEFAULT NULL,
  `click_id_hash` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL,
  `consent_status` enum('GRANTED','DENIED','UNSPECIFIED') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UNSPECIFIED',
  `status` enum('pending','accepted','succeeded','partial_success','failed','skipped') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  `reason` varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL,
  `provider_request_id` varchar(191) DEFAULT NULL,
  `attempt_count` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `request_metadata` json DEFAULT NULL,
  `response_metadata` json DEFAULT NULL,
  `history` json DEFAULT NULL,
  `last_error_code` varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL,
  `last_error_message` text,
  `attempted_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `completed_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uniq_google_ads_conversion_upload_dedupe` (`dedupe_key`),
  KEY `intake_config_id` (`intake_config_id`),
  KEY `google_connection_id` (`google_connection_id`),
  KEY `google_connection_assignment_id` (`google_connection_assignment_id`),
  KEY `idx_google_ads_conversion_upload_clinic` (`clinica_id`,`attempted_at`),
  KEY `idx_google_ads_conversion_upload_group` (`grupo_clinica_id`,`attempted_at`),
  KEY `idx_google_ads_conversion_upload_customer_status` (`customer_id`,`status`,`attempted_at`),
  KEY `idx_google_ads_conversion_upload_event` (`event_id`),
  KEY `idx_google_ads_conversion_upload_destination` (`destination_key`,`status`,`attempted_at`),
  CONSTRAINT `GoogleAdsConversionUploadAttempts_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`clinica_id`) REFERENCES `Clinicas` (`id_clinica`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `GoogleAdsConversionUploadAttempts_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`grupo_clinica_id`) REFERENCES `GruposClinicas` (`id_grupo`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `GoogleAdsConversionUploadAttempts_ibfk_3` FOREIGN KEY (`intake_config_id`) REFERENCES `IntakeConfigs` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `GoogleAdsConversionUploadAttempts_ibfk_4` FOREIGN KEY (`google_connection_id`) REFERENCES `GoogleConnections` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `GoogleAdsConversionUploadAttempts_ibfk_5` FOREIGN KEY (`google_connection_assignment_id`) REFERENCES `GoogleConnectionAssignments` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
